input.quote: Licenses. Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, RevMed hereby grants to Sanofi an exclusive (even as to RevMed and its Affiliates), royalty-bearing license (which shall be sub-licensable solely as provided in Section 3.4) under the RevMed Licensed Technology, to Research, Develop, Manufacture, use, sell, offer for sale, import and otherwise Commercialize and exploit Products (including, for clarity, any Companion Diagnostics with respect to such Products) in the Field in the Licensed Territory.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no exclusivity, "sole supplier" or requirements obligation binding us. All exclusivity runs in our favour: the Article III licences are exclusive to Sanofi even as to RevMed (p0248, p0250), and Section 3.6 and Section 10.x confirm exclusivity operates for the licensee's benefit (p0265, p0424). Manufacturing/supply (Sections 7.1–7.3) imposes no obligation to source Product solely from RevMed — supply is to be agreed under a future Supply Agreement and RevMed must even help us establish our own third-party supply (p0359). This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity on Customer), so no redline. Two inbound constraints noted but not deviations: (i) RevMed's one-time exclusive Co-Promotion Option over a share of U.S. Detailing (p0380) is a negotiated co-promotion right conditioned on RevMed demonstrating resources to our reasonable satisfaction and lapsing if not timely exercised, not an exclusive-dealing covenant; and (ii) Section 12.2(d) gives RevMed a termination right if we pursue a Competing Product in narrow circumstances (p0493), which does not prohibit us from developing or buying elsewhere and includes an election to avoid termination.
